US.description: Covers groceries, utilities, transportation, personal care, and leisure, reflecting a typical US urban/suburban lifestyle.

IN.description: Cost of living is relatively low compared to Western countries, varying significantly between major metros and smaller towns. Includes groceries, transportation, utilities, and personal care.

SG.description: Cost of living is high, with significant expenses for groceries, dining out, and transportation. Utilities are moderate, but private car ownership is exceptionally costly.

CH.description: Exceedingly high cost for groceries, public transport, utilities, dining out, and healthcare compared to international averages.

NL.description: Covers groceries, public transport, utilities, and leisure; generally high across the country, especially in major cities.

GB.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities for a moderate lifestyle outside London.

CA.description: Estimated cost covering groceries, public transportation, utilities, and personal care items, typical for a single individual in a major city like Toronto.

AE.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, dining out, and entertainment in major cities like Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

NO.description: Cost of living is high, particularly for groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure activities.

IE.description: Reflects costs for groceries, transportation, utilities, and dining in Dublin, excluding rent.

LU.description: High cost for groceries, dining, and transportation, though salaries are generally high, and cross-border shopping can offer some savings.

AU.description: Average cost of living for major Australian cities, excluding rent, covering groceries, transport, utilities, and leisure. Costs vary by specific city and lifestyle.

QA.description: Moderate cost of living excluding housing, influenced by imported goods and services. Based on expenses for a single person.

BN.description: The cost of living is moderate, with imported goods and utilities being somewhat higher, while local food and transportation costs are relatively affordable.

MO.description: Cost of living is high, especially for imported goods and dining out. Utilities and public transportation are moderately priced.
